s: Look at the picture. The girl is ______ the clothes. 【107年會考】
e: 根據圖片，女孩正把衣服放進紙箱分類打包，故選(Ｂ)。

s: The ______ is so strong today that my hair keeps blowing in the air. 【107年會考】
e: 根據　blowing in the air　吹向空中可知天氣狀態是有風的，故選(Ｄ)風。

s: You need not only good luck but also hard work to become a ______ baseball player. 【107年會考】
e: 根據題幹語意，好運氣與努力是「成功」的要件，故選(Ｂ)。其它選項皆跟題幹不符。

s: The woman who lives next door to Ken is a ______ to him.  They have never met and he doesn’t even know her name. 【107年會考】
e: 根據題幹　They have never met and he doesn’t even know her name　可知，Ken　對於住在他隔壁的女人是完全不熟悉的，故答案選(Ｃ)。

s: With the new bus line, it is much more ______ for Fanny to go to school.  It saves her a lot of time now. 【107年會考】
e: 根據題幹　It saves her a lot of time now，新的公車路線可以幫助　Fanny　省時，再代入選項，選項(Ｄ)的語意是最符合的。

s: The factory has been throwing trash into the river for years.  Now ______ must be taken to stop this. 【107年會考】
e: (Ａ)採取行動—take action，此處採被動語態，所以　action　當作主詞。(Ｂ)冒險—take chances，語意不合。(Ｃ)運動，語意不合。(Ｄ)作筆記—take notes，語意不合。

s: The beach party tonight ______ the end of our summer vacation.  Tomorrow we are all going back home and getting ready for school. 【107年會考】
e: (Ａ)(Ｃ)(Ｄ)語意不合。

s: Anyone who reads Loren’s business plan will quickly see some serious problems in it, or ______ feel something is not right. 【107年會考】
e: (Ｂ)(Ｃ)(Ｄ)語意不合。

s: When the baby cried, Mr. Wu ______ in the kitchen and did not hear it. 【107年會考】
e: when　引導的附屬子句為過去式，因此所接續的主要子句也必須是過去時態；而根據語意，吳先生煮飯的過程中，與嬰兒哭泣的時間重疊，表示　1. 吳先生的動作先發生，2. 嬰兒開始哭時兩個動作同時進行，因此吳先生煮飯的動詞會用過去進行式表達，故選(Ｂ)。

s: I don’t have any money with me because I ______ my wallet this morning. 【107年會考】
e: 主要子句時態為現在式，because　引導的附屬子句時間副詞為　this morning，視為過去式時間，沒有其他特殊變化，因此單純選擇(Ｃ)過去式即可。

s: Dad: Have you brushed your teeth yet?  Ann: No, but I ______ before I go to bed. 【107年會考】
e: 雖然第一句使用完成式，但　Ann　用　No　來回應　Dad，後面　but I ______ before I go to bed　表達未做而「即將」要去做，因此不能用完成式（因為還沒做），所以必須選未來式；又　Ann　表達她「會」做，故須使用肯定語氣，因此答案選(Ｄ)。

s: Alice: Do you know ______ Grandma is going to visit us?  Willy: It’s next week.  She told me on the phone.  And we’ll take her to the national park. 【107年會考】
e: 根據　Willy　的第一句回應　It’s next week.（是下個禮拜），可知　Alice　的問題是問時間，因此需選選項(Ｂ)時間疑問詞。

s: It took the police lots of time ______ who entered Liu’s house and killed her one year ago. 【107年會考】
e: (Ｄ)　It / 事　take 人＋to V。

s: Many famous people visit this restaurant.  Popular singers like A-mei and Jay Chou ______ here with their friends. 【107年會考】
e: (Ｃ)被動語態：人＋be V＋p.p.。

s: I’ve wanted to read The Diary of a Young Girl for months, ______ today I finally borrowed the book from the library. 【107年會考】
e:
(Ａ)並且(Ｂ)自從(Ｃ)所以(Ｄ)直到。
連接詞and把「想要讀」和「終於借到」這兩件事實並列在一起；until則表示某動作持續到某個時間點才改變，應改為 I didn’t borrow the book until today才正確，故選(A)。

p:
克漏字測驗
　　Robert likes to take a walk in the park after work. One day when he was walking in the park, he heard a woman calling his name. He stopped to look around, but didn’t see anything 　(1)　. Shortly after Robert saw it, it was gone.
　　Though Robert felt a little strange, he did not think about it too much and sat down for a rest on a bench in the park. Then he noticed the snake he had just seen 　(2)　. Robert was too afraid to move away from the bench. Right at this moment, a woman behind him shouted, “Come here, Robert. You can’t stay on the bench like that. 　(3)　.”
　　In surprise, Robert turned around and said to the woman, “Excuse me, but that’s not a very nice thing to say, and in fact some people say I’m handsome.”
　　“I’m not talking to you,” said the woman. “I’m telling Robert, my pet snake, to get down from the bench, not you.”

【107年會考】
e: (Ａ)文中沒有提及他在找蛇，而是找女人的聲音。(Ｂ)由文意可知，他要找的是聲音而非會動的東西。(Ｃ)什麼都沒看到，除了一條小蛇。(Ｄ)　Robert　在找一個女人的聲音，而非噪音的來源。

p:
If you cannot live without your car, Zurich might be the last city you would like to visit. In Zurich, people are welcome, but cars are not! Over the past 20 years, this city has used smart ways 　(1)　. One is to keep the same total number of parking spaces. For example, if 50 new parking spaces are built in one part of the city, then 50 old spaces in other parts are taken away for other uses. So the total number does not change. Some are unhappy that there are never enough spaces. That is just what the city has in mind: If people find parking more difficult, they will drive less.
　　　(2)　, the total number of cars in the city is counted. Over 3,500 little computers are put under Zurich roads to check the number of cars that enter the city. If the number is higher than the city can deal with, the traffic lights on the roads that enter the city will be kept red. So drivers who are traveling into Zurich have to stop and wait until there are fewer cars in the city. Now, you may wonder 　(3)　. The answer is simple: The city wants to make more space for its people.

【107年會考】
o: to make itself a famous city
e: 本題前一句提到「在蘇黎世，人們會受到熱烈歡迎，但車子卻不會！」，後面則提到這個城市維持一定停車位的作法來減少人們開車，故答案選(Ａ)　to make traffic lighter。

s: (１)　What is the reading mostly about?
p: 【107年會考】

How to choose a nice holiday apartment.
Why one should choose a holiday apartment.
How one can change their house into a holiday apartment.

s: (１)　Which season is this poem（詩）about?
p:
The sky is turning bright and clear.
The earth is wearing red and green.
Winter is gone; spring has come.
The air smells fresh and sweet.
The summer heat is not yet here;
A little fox comes out to play.
A bird is busy in a tree
Waking a daisy from her sleep.
Little daisy, little daisy,
People call the flower the “day’s eye.”
When she opens her eye,
The springtime brings us cheer.
【107年會考】
e: 根據第一段　Winter is gone; spring has come.，本句使用完成式，表達動作已完成，可知春天已經來臨，故選(Ａ)。

s: (１)　What does the reading say about shaking?
p:
When we get wet, we need a towel to get ourselves dry. When a dog gets wet, all it needs is to shake its body. A study in 2010 showed that a wet dog can throw off half the water on its body by shaking for less than a second. In fact, this common act of dogs works better than a washing machine.

　　The study found that animal shaking begins with the head and ends with the tail. During a shake, the animal’s head, body and skin all move. Smaller animals must shake faster than bigger animals to get water off. For example, in one second, a rat can shake 18 times, a dog 6 times, and a bear 4 times. Bigger animals can get their bodies dry with fewer shakes.
　　For animals, shaking is not just about getting themselves dry. It is also about saving their lives. Being wet makes animals heavier, and that makes it harder to run. In the animal world, how fast an animal can run often decides whether it will live or not. Maybe that’s why the “wet-dog shake” has become a common habit of many animals.

【107年會考】
o: Different animals’ shaking begins with different body parts.
Shaking is a way that animals use to make other animals scared.
Animals that are not kept as pets do the shaking better than those that are.
Shaking themselves dry may help animals run faster in dangerous moments.
e: 選項(Ａ)錯誤，因第二段的說明並無指出不同動物甩動身體部位的順序也有不同。選項(Ｂ)錯誤，因第三段指出，動物甩動身體是為了弄乾及保命，並沒有提到嚇退其他動物。選項(Ｃ)錯誤，因第二段說明，小型動物甩動次數比大型動物多，而非野生動物或寵物的甩動能力差別。第三段說明動物身體潮溼與生命安危的關係，故選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)　What does things like that mean?
p:
Josh: Do you know about “pay it forward coffee” at Flora Café?
Eric: You mean you pay for a cup of coffee for someone poor to have it later?
Josh: Yeah. A cup of coffee is not much, but on cold winter days like today, it might warm them up a little. And maybe their hearts too.
Eric: But will Flora Café really give this cup of coffee to someone later?
Josh: Come on. I’ve known the shopkeeper well. He’s an honest man. He’s got a blackboard in the shop that says how many cups are paid for and how many have been given out.
Eric: But how will they know who to give? Anyone can ask for it, even if they’re not poor.
Josh: True, but then I guess they’ll just have to believe in people.
Eric: Perhaps. But will poor people go and ask for a free coffee? Won’t they worry about losing face?
Josh: Why do you always say things like that?
Eric: Well, it may happen.
Josh: Yeah, I know, but I still think it’s a good thing to do, and it gets people to care about others.

【107年會考】
o: Problems about the free coffee plan.
Trouble for people who go to Flora Café.
Ways to make the free coffee plan successful.
Good things free coffee will bring to Flora Café.
e: 根據對話內容，things like that　的上一句是　Eric　質疑窮人來索取免費咖啡時，是否會擔心丟臉，因此在此可推判答案為這項免費咖啡計畫會遇到的問題，故選(Ａ)。

s: (２)　What can we learn about Josh and Eric?
p:
Josh: Do you know about “pay it forward coffee” at Flora Café?
Eric: You mean you pay for a cup of coffee for someone poor to have it later?
Josh: Yeah. A cup of coffee is not much, but on cold winter days like today, it might warm them up a little. And maybe their hearts too.
Eric: But will Flora Café really give this cup of coffee to someone later?
Josh: Come on. I’ve known the shopkeeper well. He’s an honest man. He’s got a blackboard in the shop that says how many cups are paid for and how many have been given out.
Eric: But how will they know who to give? Anyone can ask for it, even if they’re not poor.
Josh: True, but then I guess they’ll just have to believe in people.
Eric: Perhaps. But will poor people go and ask for a free coffee? Won’t they worry about losing face?
Josh: Why do you always say things like that?
Eric: Well, it may happen.
Josh: Yeah, I know, but I still think it’s a good thing to do, and it gets people to care about others.

【107年會考】
o: Josh was not able to change Eric’s mind about free coffee.
Eric has more hope for the free coffee plan than Josh does.
They found a way to make people feel OK to take free coffee.
They do not know whether Flora Café will do business honestly.
e: 根據對話內容，Eric　對於「請下一位喝咖啡」活動，直到對話結束前，仍有很多疑問，因此我們可推論　Josh　無法改變　Eric　對該計畫的看法，故選(Ａ)。選項(Ｂ)　Eric 比 Josh　對免費咖啡計畫更懷抱希望。應該是　Josh 對這項計畫更有信心。選項(Ｃ)他們找到一個讓大家感到適切的方式取得免費咖啡。對話內容沒有提及。選項(Ｄ)他們不知道花兒咖啡是否會誠實經營。由　Josh 的　I’ve known the shopkeeper well.  He’s an honest man. 可知　Josh　認為花兒咖啡廳會誠實執行這項計畫，故選項(Ｄ)與內容不符。

s: (３)　What do we know about Flora Café from the dialogue?
p:
Josh: Do you know about “pay it forward coffee” at Flora Café?
Eric: You mean you pay for a cup of coffee for someone poor to have it later?
Josh: Yeah. A cup of coffee is not much, but on cold winter days like today, it might warm them up a little. And maybe their hearts too.
Eric: But will Flora Café really give this cup of coffee to someone later?
Josh: Come on. I’ve known the shopkeeper well. He’s an honest man. He’s got a blackboard in the shop that says how many cups are paid for and how many have been given out.
Eric: But how will they know who to give? Anyone can ask for it, even if they’re not poor.
Josh: True, but then I guess they’ll just have to believe in people.
Eric: Perhaps. But will poor people go and ask for a free coffee? Won’t they worry about losing face?
Josh: Why do you always say things like that?
Eric: Well, it may happen.
Josh: Yeah, I know, but I still think it’s a good thing to do, and it gets people to care about others.

【107年會考】
o: It has a way to know who really is poor.
Free coffee has brought it more business.
People pay less for free coffee than other coffee.
Its blackboard shows if there are free coffees to be taken.
e: 根據內容，Josh　提及咖啡廳黑板上寫多少杯咖啡已送出，故選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)(Ｂ)(Ｃ)均未在內容提及。

s:
(１)　Below are the writer’s points in the reading:
a. Whether we should stop tribespeople whaling
b. The problem of whaling
c. Whaling as a way of life
In what order（順序）does the writer talk about his points?
p: 【107年會考】
e: 從文章第一段可以得知作者首先提出捕鯨問題及影響。第二、三段提出捕鯨行為早在很久以前就是部落人們賴以生存的活動。最後提出，我們全面性的阻止各種捕鯨行為是否就是最正確的選擇。因此答案應選　b-c-a。

s: (２)　Which idea may the writer agree with?
p: 【107年會考】
o: We should stop all kinds of whale hunting.
We should not worry about the number of whales.
Tribespeople’s way of living is as important as animal lives.
Working with the whaling business can make tribespeople’s lives better.
e: (Ａ)我們應全面禁止各種捕鯨行為。作者認為捕鯨是部落人民的一種生存方式，並非主要鯨魚大量減少的主要原因。(Ｂ)我們不應該擔心鯨魚的數量。作者第一段提到鯨魚大量銳減，人們擔心未來後代只能從照片認識鯨魚。(Ｄ)與獵鯨商業合作將有助於改善部落人民的生活。文章中並無提到，且最後一段提到，鯨魚銳減有　90％是因為商業捕鯨。

s: (３)　What can we learn from the reading?
p: 【107年會考】
o: Tribespeople believe whales bring good luck.
Tribespeople become rich by selling whale oil.
Whaling was not a problem until 1,500 years ago.
Whaling helped tribespeople’s lives in different ways.
e: (Ａ)部落人民相信鯨魚能帶來好運。文章中並未提到。(Ｂ)部落人民靠著販售鯨魚油致富。根據文章第三段可以得知，將鯨魚油作為蠟燭、油燈為部落的生存方式，但並未提到以此為依據的商業行為獲得以致富。(Ｃ)捕鯨行為並非我們應擔心的問題，直到　1500　年前。根據文章第三段得知，最早的捕鯨行為始於　1500　年前，當時還只是部落人民生存的一種方式，並未有大量的商業行為，因此尚未形成捕鯨問題。

s: (１)　From the news story, which fact is seen as a new turn?
p: 【107年會考】
o: Carolyn Cole is a first-time writer.
Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize.
Carolyn Cole is not the winner’s real name.
Carolyn Cole did not appear for the Inscriber Prize.
e: (Ａ)第二段已知她是首次出書作者。(Ｂ)第二段已提及她贏得此獎項。(Ｃ)第三段提到　Cole　並非真實存在的作者，而是　Thomas Goode　的化名。(Ｄ)第二段已知她未出席領獎。

s: (２)　Which is most likely（可能）true about the Inscriber Prize?
p: 【107年會考】
o: It was started by NBN News.
It is a new prize for picture books.
It is a prize only for first-time writers.
It is treated seriously by writers in the country.
e: (Ａ)文中沒有提及。(Ｂ)並非是單為繪本而設立。(Ｃ)文中沒有提及。(Ｄ)第二段提及得獎人未出席領獎是前所未見的事，可得知此項事實。

s: (３)　What can we learn about Thomas Goode?
p: 【107年會考】
o: He has won the Inscriber Prize twice.
He told NBN that Paper Solider was his work.
He wants to be more than just a picture book writer.
His life as a picture book writer has not been successful.
e: (Ａ)第三段只提到是國家圖書獎，並未提到是此獎項。(Ｂ)最後一段提到他本人並未回覆　NBN。(Ｄ)第三段有提到他的成名作銷量百萬。

s: (４)　What do we know about Thomas Goode’s books?
p: 【107年會考】
o: The sales of Parent were bad.
Paper Soldier is his best-selling book.
His first picture book came out in 2006.
Blue Moon was written under a different name.
e: (Ａ)第四段提到。(Ｂ)只提到得獎沒提到銷量，也尚未和本人確認作者是否就是他。(Ｃ)「父母」才是。(Ｄ)由第三段得知，藍月是以　Thomas Goode　之名完成的書。
